update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.51 - Trackblazer Shop detection fix and log cleanup
Fixes ----- - Fixed Trackblazer's Shop-opening flow failing outright when the Shop button or Training Items button wasn't detected on the first frame checked (e.g. right as the Main Screen loads). Both checks now use the function's existing retry budget instead of giving up after a single attempt. - Downgraded an expected "no dialog matched" log line from ERROR to VERBOSE. This fired on most ordinary screen transitions where no dialog is present and had no functional impact, just noisy logs.
